description: Save a ChatGPT ad DRAFT under the current user. Does not launch, reserve funds or spend money. Returns the creative and current quote for review in chat. Use start_chatgpt_ad only after the user approves the exact budget, service fee, duration and oriiion shared advertiser identity. No campaign-builder page is needed.

bidCents.description: Maximum bid in wallet minor units; must not exceed the budget.

budgetCents.description: Lifetime media budget in wallet minor units (50000 means 500.00). Read the currency with get_chatgpt_ads.

countries.description: Uppercase country codes from get_chatgpt_ads availability.countries.

durationDays.description: Campaign duration starting at launch: whole days from 1 to 30.

imageUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of a static JPEG/PNG/WebP, at least 640×640 pixels. Use an uploaded or generated image.

requestKey.description: Generate one UUID for this operation and reuse it on retries.

name: create_chatgpt_ad
